9542d050508faea6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الباحة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، تقدير المواد، متابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال لضمان سلامة وكفاءة الأنظمة الكهربائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية لمختلف المشاريع (المنزلية، الصناعية، التجارية) ومكوناتها بدقة. تقدير الكميات المطلوبة من المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية، وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات مع مطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، والإشراف على تشغيل دارات التمديدات، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. فهم عميق لمخططات التمديدات الكهربائية وقدرة على قراءتها وتطبيقها. معرفة جيدة بأنواع المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية ومواصفاتها. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وتحديد الحلول المناسبة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات فنية قوية في تركيب وصيانة التمديدات الكهربائية. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. مهارات حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرار. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الباحة، المملكة العربية السعودية. تتطلب العمل في مواقع المشاريع المختلفة التابعة لشركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

9505f7291251dd04.description: About the Role Jeddah Central Development Company (JCDC) is seeking a Corporate Finance & Transaction Advisory Director to lead its financial strategy. This full-time position, based in Jeddah or Makkah, requires a professional with over 10 years of experience. The Director will be responsible for driving investment and funding strategies, evaluating and supporting transaction execution, and optimizing value through strategic oversight. The role involves acting as a key advisor to the management team, ensuring financial decisions align with JCDC’s long-term goals and shareholder interests. Key Accountabilities Lead the development and refinement of JCDC’s Business Plan, Investment & Funding Strategy, and Detailed Funding Plan. Assess and implement strategies to optimize the balance sheet to improve Return on Invested Capital (ROIC). Prepare materials for the Investment and Funding Committee and implement directives from the committee. Advise the company’s Executive Management on investment and funding matters to ensure informed decision-making. Collaborate with JCDC’s shareholders on financial report development to ensure timely delivery. Deal Evaluation and Execution Collaborate with stakeholders to prepare for capital raising activities, ensuring all necessary documentation and strategies are in place. Develop compelling marketing materials to attract potential deals. Conduct pre-deal due diligence activities to assess the viability and risks of potential deals. Lead the development of deal-specific sensitivity analysis and scenario modeling to evaluate potential outcomes. Structure, negotiate, and close transactions to ensure favorable terms for the company. Value Creation and Optimization Monitor the company’s active and current investments to ensure expected performance. Contribute to the preparation of investment reports and performance updates for stakeholders. Analyze the company’s portfolio to identify potential opportunities for optimization and growth. Analyze and propose potential divestments or exit opportunities to the Deal Evaluation & Execution team. Assist with merger and acquisition (M&A) integration activities to achieve intended synergies and maximize predicted value. Strategy and Leadership Develop and direct the implementation of the Corporate Finance and Transactions department strategy, ensuring alignment with divisional strategy, JCDC’s vision, mission, and corporate objectives. Provide subject matter expertise and strategic counsel to JCDC leadership on corporate finance, investment, funding, and transaction matters. Manage the effective achievement of departmental objectives through leadership, setting individual objectives, managing performance, and developing and motivating the team. Lead talent development initiatives for the assigned department, collaborating with discipline experts and ensuring talent availability to fit business requirements. Financial Management and Compliance Oversee the consolidation and recommendation of the department budget, monitoring financial performance against the budget. Develop and lead the implementation of department policies, systems, processes, procedures, and controls to fulfill relevant procedural and legislative requirements. Lead change management through continuous improvement of department systems, processes, and practices, considering global standards and changes in the business environment. Ensure all department reports are prepared timely and accurately, meeting JCDC requirements, policies, and quality standards.

9594bb34f87dbbee.description: About the Role National Medical Care is seeking a Pharmacy Encoder to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is central to ensuring accurate prescription processing and efficient stock management within the pharmacy. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The Pharmacy Encoder is responsible for the precise checking and encoding of prescriptions, managing medicine requests from the Pharmacy Store, and processing take-home prescriptions. This includes categorizing prescriptions by financial type and maintaining daily statistics for all dispensed medicines. The role also involves overseeing the movement of pharmaceutical stocks between the Pharmacy Store, Inpatient Pharmacy, wards, patients, and other departments. Key Responsibilities Ensure high-quality medical treatment, compassion, and understanding for all patients at NMC Hospitals and Clinics. Perform receptionist and related clerical duties as required. Verify that all medicines are accurately charged to patients by checking entries made by Pharmacists and Clerks in the Wards. Initiate and maintain patient departmental records in accordance with established policies and procedures. Properly organize and file recent memos, charging policies, lists of contracted companies, and updated exclusion lists. Maintain a smooth flow of OPD prescriptions, take-home prescriptions, and other pharmacy-related requirements. Answer telephone calls promptly and courteously, ensuring accurate and complete message relaying. Update patient accounts and communicate with other departments for daily updates. Manage the requesting, receiving, and acceptance of deliveries from the Pharmacy Store and suppliers within the computer system. Comply with the hospital dress code. Perform other applicable tasks and duties assigned within the scope of the employee’s knowledge, skills, and abilities. Reporting Structure This position reports directly to the Head of Pharmacy and Pharmacy Supervisors, ensuring clear guidance and support in daily operations. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2-5 years of experience in a relevant pharmacy or healthcare administrative role. Demonstrated ability to accurately check prescriptions and manage stock. Proficiency in using computer systems for inventory and patient record management. Strong organizational and communication skills. Work Environment The Pharmacy Encoder will operate within the dynamic environment of National Medical Care's hospitals and clinics in Riyadh, contributing to the efficient functioning of the pharmacy department and patient care.

959ac3683365a732.description: About the Role National Medical Care is seeking a Sr. Registrar Emergency Medicine to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves providing comprehensive patient care within the Emergency Room department, maintaining high professional standards under the supervision of a Consultant or Head of ER. The position requires adherence to professional medical ethics, CBAHI/JCIA standards, hospital by-laws, and Ministry of Health regulations. Key Responsibilities Provide patient care within the scope of clinical privileges, ensuring high-quality medical treatment and compassion. Practice within clinically relevant and scientifically valid standards and guidelines. Participate in the development and maintenance of medical contingency disaster plans. Maintain the quality of the triage system performed by Emergency Room Nurses. Supervise the performance of assigned ER physicians. Perform diagnostic and therapeutic procedures within the specialty as per privileges. Assess and refer appropriate patients to other medical facilities. Participate in the departmental on-call rota for patient care. Uphold patient rights regarding security, confidentiality, and privacy. Respond to emergencies, offering advice and active participation as required. Maintain accurate, timely, and legible patient medical records. Supervise duties of assigned junior staff. Provide leadership for performance improvement functions as part of the Departmental Quality Plan. Actively participate in Continued Medical Education (CME) through hospital activities and national/international meetings. Participate in training programs for junior medical staff, nursing staff, and technicians. Continuously update medical knowledge and upgrade professional skills. Participate in assigned committee meetings (*, Quality Improvement, Infection Control). Abide by department policies, procedures, hospital by-laws, rules, and regulations. Educate patients and families according to their needs, involving them in the plan of care and respecting their goals and choices. Provide health promotion and teaching appropriate to the patient's developmental level, learning needs, and cultural background. Allot time to assess, plan, implement, and evaluate patient education, ensuring proper documentation. Perform other applicable tasks and duties within the realm of knowledge, skills, and abilities. Qualifications and Experience Education: Graduation from an accredited medical school (MBBS) with completion of required training. A Post Graduate/Master's degree or equivalent qualification is required. Valid Basic Life Support (BLS) and Advanced Life Support certifications are also necessary. Higher qualifications in the specialty are desirable. Experience: A minimum of two (2) years of experience in the specialty after obtaining a Post Graduate Degree and registration is required. Candidates should possess a current valid license to practice medicine in their specialty and registration with the Saudi Medical Council, or a current license to practice medicine in Saudi Arabia as a Senior Registrar. Five (5) years of experience in the specialty after obtaining a Post Graduate Degree is desirable. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia.

95aa6e9ea905a6ae.description: About Jeddah Transport Company Jeddah Transport Company is seeking an Internal Audit Specialist to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is designed for professionals with 0-1 years of experience who are ready to contribute to the company's internal audit functions. Role Overview The Internal Audit Specialist will be responsible for executing audit procedures and supporting the Internal Audit Director in various tasks. This role involves ensuring compliance with audit methodologies, documenting findings, and contributing to the continuous improvement of audit practices. Key Responsibilities Perform assigned audit procedures, including walkthroughs, testing, and data analysis, in accordance with approved audit programs and internal audit methodology. Gather, organize, and document sufficient, reliable, relevant, and useful evidence to support audit findings and conclusions. Prepare clear and well-organized working papers that accurately reflect work performed and support audit conclusions, for review by the Internal Audit Director. Identify control deficiencies, exceptions, and potential risks encountered during fieldwork, and escalate them to the Internal Audit Director for evaluation. Assist in drafting audit observations and supporting documentation for review, ensuring accuracy and completeness before inclusion in draft reports. Support follow-up procedures on agreed corrective actions by verifying implementation evidence and reporting status to the Internal Audit Director. Assist in the preparation of risk assessments, engagement planning documentation, and data requests under the guidance of the Internal Audit Director. Maintain the confidentiality of audit information and comply with the Internal Audit Charter, Code of Ethics, and applicable professional standards. Support special reviews, whistleblowing-related fieldwork, or advisory assignments as directed by the Internal Audit Director. Contribute to the continuous improvement of Internal Audit tools, templates, and working practices as assigned. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in internal audit or a related field. Strong understanding of internal audit methodologies and professional standards. Ability to gather, organize, and document audit evidence effectively. Excellent attention to detail and analytical skills. Proficiency in preparing clear and concise working papers and reports. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The Internal Audit Specialist will work closely with the Internal Audit Director and other team members to ensure the integrity and effectiveness of the company's internal controls.

950d09ee85ed43cc.description: About the Role ZainTECH is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer, Enterprise Services, to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves the administration, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise IT infrastructure and Microsoft-based technology solutions within ZainTECH's customer environments. The Senior Systems Engineer ensures the availability, performance, security, and reliability of critical infrastructure services, provides advanced technical support, and maintains operational standards in line with customer requirements and industry best practices. Working closely with customers, technical delivery teams, Project Managers, and other infrastructure specialists, this role supports the full lifecycle of enterprise infrastructure solutions, including deployment, configuration, migration, troubleshooting, and ongoing maintenance. The position also contributes to infrastructure improvements, technical documentation, and knowledge transfer to ensure effective service delivery and long-term operational stability. Key Responsibilities Administer, maintain, and support enterprise IT infrastructure and Microsoft-based systems across customer environments. Perform daily, weekly, and monthly operational activities to ensure the availability, performance, and reliability of critical infrastructure services. Monitor system health, capacity, and performance, proactively identifying and addressing potential operational issues. Implement and maintain system configurations, security controls, and operational procedures in accordance with established best practices. Provide advanced technical support to enterprise customers through on-site and remote troubleshooting. Investigate, diagnose, and resolve infrastructure incidents, system failures, and performance-related issues. Install, configure, deploy, and integrate enterprise infrastructure solutions according to approved technical designs and customer requirements. Support and supervise infrastructure migrations, upgrades, and system modernization activities while minimizing disruption. Administer and support Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services, identity management, authentication, and access control solutions. Support Microsoft Exchange Server and Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, and OneDrive. Configure and maintain Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization environments and related infrastructure services. Administer Microsoft Azure infrastructure services, including virtual machines, virtual networks, and storage accounts. Perform system integration testing, configuration validation, and operational readiness assessments for implemented solutions. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including system configurations, implementation records, and operational procedures. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. 4-6 years of experience in Microsoft infrastructure administration, enterprise systems engineering, or related IT infrastructure roles. Hands-on experience administering and supporting Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Exchange Server and Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, and OneDrive. Experience with Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization technologies. Working knowledge of Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS) and hybrid identity environments. Experience configuring and supporting Microsoft SQL Server infrastructure. Familiarity with Microsoft System Center products and enterprise infrastructure management technologies. Hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Azure services, including IaaS (Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Storage Accounts), Identity & Access Management (Microsoft Entra ID, PIM, Azure AD Connect), Enterprise Mobility & Security (Microsoft Intune), Monitoring & Operations (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics), and Backup & Disaster Recovery (Azure Site Recovery, Azure Backup). Experience supporting infrastructure implementation, system upgrades, migrations, and technical troubleshooting. Good understanding of enterprise infrastructure security, system availability, performance optimization, and operational best practices. Required Skills Strong technical documentation and reporting skills. Good written and verbal communication skills in both English and Arabic. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires collaboration with customers, technical delivery teams, Project Managers, and other infrastructure specialists.

957dcb23715b7099.description: About the Role ProgressSoft is seeking a Pre-Sales Consultant to join its team. This full-time role involves advising Business Development and Sales teams on complex deals, addressing technical and product inquiries, and guiding customers on the effective implementation of ProgressSoft’s systems. The consultant will serve as a product specialist with a deep understanding of product integrations and enterprise features. The position requires 0-1 years of experience and involves a bold travel schedule of up to 30%. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with sales and business development teams to identify sales opportunities for the company’s product suite. Engage with customers and prospects to qualify opportunities and develop solution constructs. Support the BD/Sales team in qualifying customer needs and conducting pre-demo needs analysis. Lead techno-functional discussions during client interactions and pre-sales, accurately capturing customer requirements. Act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for the entire pre-sales cycle, including requirement scoping, product fitment, solutioning, and technical proposal creation, in coordination with sales, delivery, product, and support teams. Draft solution scope documents that meet customer expectations and translate them for estimation and successful delivery. Develop product demo scripts and scenarios, and orchestrate product demonstrations and workshops. Manage, coordinate, and execute the complete bidding process for RFIs and RFPs. Prepare statements of work and other contractual documents as needed. Perform other tasks as reasonably required. Required Qualifications and Skills Self-initiation and strong problem-solving skills. High level of performance and detail-oriented approach. Outstanding leadership qualities and team-building skills. Excellent communication capabilities, both written and verbal, to represent the company effectively. Highly organized with excellent follow-up skills. Ability to work under pressure and influence others. Proficiency in preparing PowerPoint presentations, documents, and analysis reports. Ability to initiate conversations and make a lasting impact. Good knowledge of global real-time, rails, retail payments, and the broader payments landscape. Fair understanding of Real-time Payments globally, including PSD2, Open Banking, Payment Hub, SWIFT, and SEPA. Ability to conduct SWOT analysis on solution offerings and position the company’s products against competitors in various geographies. Commitment to staying updated with market knowledge in the payment domain and relevant geographical advancements. Experience Level This role requires 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Work Environment This is a full-time position that involves a travel schedule of up to 30%.

957f444d29924484.description: About the Role Matar Holding Company is seeking a Sales Representative to join their team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time role focuses on driving sales and expanding the customer base within the animal feed industry. The ideal candidate will build strong relationships with livestock and poultry farmers, feed distributors, and other industry stakeholders. Role Overview The Sales Representative will be responsible for promoting and selling animal nutrition products, including poultry and livestock feed. This position requires effective communication with diverse clients, necessitating fluency in both Arabic and English. The role involves regular customer engagement to generate new business and maintain existing accounts while achieving assigned sales targets. Key Responsibilities Identify and approach potential customers, including poultry farms, livestock farms, distributors, and dealers. Promote and sell poultry feed, livestock feed, and other animal nutrition products. Conduct regular customer visits to generate new business and maintain existing accounts. Develop strong relationships with farmers, farm owners, purchasing managers, and key decision-makers. Achieve monthly and annual sales targets as assigned by the Sales Manager. Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable feed products. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and pricing. Prepare quotations, follow up on customer orders, and coordinate deliveries. Follow up on outstanding payments and support timely collection. Maintain accurate records of customer visits, sales activities, orders, and market feedback. Coordinate with the production and logistics teams to ensure timely product availability and delivery. Prepare regular sales reports and provide updates to the Sales Manager. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of sales experience, preferably in animal feed, poultry feed, livestock feed, or animal nutrition. Experience in B2B sales and customer relationship management. Existing contacts with poultry farms, livestock farms, and feed distributors in Saudi Arabia are an advantage. Fluency in both Arabic and English is required for effective communication. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Eastern Region. The role involves regular field visits to customers and coordination with internal teams to ensure operational efficiency and customer satisfaction. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

95b375ddaa6cd0f5.description: About the Role stc is seeking a Project Management Assistant Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing and managing the end-to-end implementation of strategic projects and initiatives, ensuring successful deployment, integration, and testing while coordinating with relevant stakeholders. The role holder will operate in accordance with stipulated business policies and procedures. Key Responsibilities Provide end-to-end implementation oversight and management for all strategic projects and initiatives. Align with STS strategy and internal teams regarding the implementation of various strategic projects. Develop the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) for implementation and align the plan with customer technical implementation teams. Identify potential risks and challenges impacting implementation and develop mitigation strategies. Execute the deployment of security solutions according to approved designs and plans, ensuring correct setup of all solution components. Manage suppliers, Managed Services vendors, and stc stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of products and services. Engage with the Technical Solutions and Operations departments early in the delivery phase and raise any required changes or constraints. Conduct regular progress reviews and status updates to track project performance and address deviations. Hold regular status meetings and communicate with stakeholders to provide project updates. Integrate solutions with stc’s network/systems in coordination with stc Tech&Ops and other STS systems in coordination with STS’s Technical Operations department. Develop comprehensive testing strategies to validate system functionality, integration, and performance across all project phases. Conduct Provisional Acceptance Testing (PAT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Functional/Integration Testing of security solution components. Share testing results with Technical Operations to ensure seamless handover of solutions. Evaluate testing results, fix integration issues (if required), and engage with the design team for any queries (if required). Application Process Further details regarding the application process and salary will be disclosed to qualified candidates.

95da29e049f3138f.description: About Eram Talent Eram Talent is currently seeking qualified and experienced professionals for multiple full-time opportunities within the Upstream & Drilling sector in Saudi Arabia. We are looking for talented individuals across various disciplines within the Oil & Gas industry. 95f8232d9921ea18.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الشارع السادس للتجارة عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، ترويج المنتجات، وإتمام عمليات البيع بكفاءة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات. المهام الرئيسية يتولى مندوب المبيعات مسؤولية إدارة دورة المبيعات الكاملة، بدءاً من تحديد العملاء المحتملين وصولاً إلى تحصيل الديون. تشمل المهام اليومية جمع البيانات، تقديم عروض البيع، ومتابعة العملاء لضمان رضاهم. المسؤوليات بناء قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء أو زيارتهم لترويج المنتجات (السلع والخدمات) وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزاتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة، وإتمام عملية البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على جمع البيانات وتحليل مواصفات المنتجات. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على إتمام عمليات البيع وتحصيل الديون. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المرشح ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي يركز على تحقيق الأهداف وتوسيع قاعدة العملاء. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة الشارع السادس للتجارة.

95b52f262fd769be.description: كاشير/باريستا ضمان تجربة عملاء ممتازة من خلال إدارة عمليات النقد بكفاءة وإعداد مشروبات القهوة عالية الجودة. المسؤوليات الأساسية: إعداد جميع أنواع مشروبات الإسبريسو والقهوة (الساخنة والباردة) وفقاً للمعايير المحددة. استقبال طلبات العملاء بترحيب وتسجيلها بدقة. إدارة جميع المعاملات النقدية. الحفاظ على نظافة منطقة العمل والمعدات والالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة. القدرة على العمل بفعالية تحت ضغط وفي أوقات الذروة.

95c63950457cfdaa.description: About the Role Nahdi Medical Co. is seeking a Pharmacist to join their team in Afif, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves providing general healthcare advice, dispensing medication, and supervising retail store operations to ensure sales targets, customer satisfaction, and operational readiness are consistently met. The position requires 1-3 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Ensure store readiness by monitoring compliance with internal guidelines, including staff appearance and store conditions (temperature, storage). Perform duties in alignment with Standard Operating Procedures, including loyalty program registration. Process prescriptions and dispense medication, providing consultation on dosage, storage, side effects, and drug interactions. Educate customers on the proper handling of medical equipment for home use, such as glucose meters. Supervise retail store staff, providing development opportunities through performance management, corrective actions, and coaching. Monitor key sales performance targets and customer satisfaction levels through direct observation and regular reporting. Process payments and reconciliations, handling the cash register and coordinating with the Finance team. Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities by consulting with customers and proposing appropriate products. Perform operational and staff-related administrative tasks, including workflow monitoring, team scheduling, order verification, stock logistics, inventory management, expense management, and promotion execution. Ensure compliance with Health & Safety policies and procedures, as well as local industry legal requirements. Dispense and provide advice on over-the-counter medication for common illnesses, including symptom checking and specific consultation. Qualifications and Experience 1-3 years of experience in a relevant field. Ability to provide general healthcare advice and dispense prescription and non-prescription medication. Proficiency in supervising retail store teams and operations. 955122a2a8da1b66.description: تعلن شركة تطوير عن توفر شاغر وظيفي بمسمى مشرف مبيعات للعمل ضمن مشاريعها في قطاع الاتصالات. المهام والمسؤوليات: * الإشراف والمتابعة: الإشراف على فريق مندوبي المبيعات ومتابعة أدائهم اليومي لضمان تحقيق الأهداف البيعية. * التخطيط الميداني: إعداد الخطط والاستراتيجيات الميدانية لزيادة المبيعات وتوسيع قاعدة العملاء. * مؤشرات الأداء: متابعة مؤشرات الأداء والمستهدفات البيعية والعمل على تحسين النتائج. * تطوير الفريق: تطوير مهارات فريق المبيعات وتحفيزه وتقديم التوجيه والدعم المستمر. * التدريب والتأهيل: تدريب وتأهيل مندوبي المبيعات الجدد ومتابعة مستوى أدائهم. * إعداد التقارير: إعداد التقارير اليومية الخاصة بالمبيعات وأداء الفريق. * تنظيم العمل: تنظيم جداول العمل وتوزيع المواقع البيعية بما يضمن التغطية الفعالة لنقاط البيع. * حل المشكلات: معالجة التحديات والمشكلات اليومية وضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. * الالتزام بالسياسات: متابعة التزام الفريق بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة وتقديم التوصيات اللازمة لتطوير الأداء. المتطلبات: * خبرة سابقة في الإشراف على فرق المبيعات، ويفضل في قطاع الاتصالات. * امتلاك مهارات قيادية وقدرة على إدارة وتحفيز فرق العمل. * القدرة على تحقيق الأهداف البيعية ومتابعة مؤشرات الأداء. * مهارات عالية في التواصل والتفاوض وحل المشكلات. * الاستعداد للعمل الميداني والتنقل بين المواقع البيعية. المميزات الوظيفية: * الراتب الأساسي: 4,000 ريال سعودي. * العمولات: عمولات تصاعدية مجزية حسب الأداء والمبيعات. * تدريب منتهي بالتوظيف.

9503df582fa03da7.description: About V2X Inc. and the Role V2X Inc. is a global company that develops integrated physical and digital infrastructure solutions. With 120 years of mission support experience, V2X focuses on enhancing security, streamlining logistics, and improving readiness for clients worldwide. The company operates with 16,000 employees and an annual revenue of $ billion, committed to integrity, respect, responsibility, and professionalism. This full-time position for a UH Phase Team Lead (1st Shift) is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Role Overview The UH Phase Team Lead is responsible for conducting comprehensive maintenance on UH60 aircraft, adhering to specific guidelines from OEM manuals and other directives. This role involves executing both scheduled and unscheduled maintenance actions, utilizing specialized tools and equipment, and ensuring all operations prioritize safety. The Team Lead will also be responsible for developing and executing phase plans from pre-dock to post-test flight. Key Responsibilities Plan, coordinate, integrate, and synchronize UH60 aircraft maintenance activities to achieve established platform operational readiness objectives. Ensure compliance with established maintenance systems, processes, procedures, and reporting for immediate situational awareness of platform readiness rates. Establish daily maintenance operational goals, objectives, and priorities to achieve stated readiness rates and MNG training objectives. Oversee the daily maintenance management of individually assigned aircraft in support of the Aviation Maintenance Manager. Work within established maintenance quality control processes, procedures, and standards. Direct inquiries, investigations, and research analysis related to UH60 aircraft aviation maintenance and supporting activities to the Production Control (PC) Manager. Support Downed Aircraft Recovery Team (DART) processes and procedures in coordination with the PC Manager. Perform other tasks as directed by the PC Manager. Aircraft Maintenance Duties Remove and install aircraft systems, subsystem assemblies, and components, including engines, rotors, gearboxes, transmissions, and mechanical flight controls. Service and lubricate aircraft systems, subsystems, and components, preparing aircraft for inspections and maintenance checks. Execute scheduled and unscheduled maintenance actions using common and precision measuring tools, as well as alignment fixtures. Perform routine and special inspections on aircraft and related components, along with maintenance operational checks. Diagnose and troubleshoot aircraft subsystems using special tools and equipment. Perform operator maintenance on tools, special tools, and Aircraft Ground Support Equipment (AGSE). Prepare meticulous aircraft maintenance forms and records. Qualifications and Experience Education: Associate's degree or higher is required due to visa requirements. An Associate’s Degree is preferred. Experience: Five (5) to ten (10) years of experience as an aircraft mechanic on UH60 series aircraft is required, with at least three (3) years specifically on UH60 series. Experience in UH60 phase or RESET management is also required. Background: Military background with experience in aviation maintenance and logistics. Certifications: FAA A&P certificate and FAA IA certificate are required. Saudi Arabia Employment Requirement: All candidates must successfully complete the Saudi Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development’s Qualification Verification Program (QVP) to ensure eligibility for visa processing and employment authorization.

950475e815a514eb.description: About the Role Wood (KSA) is seeking a TPE V / Process Safety / Major Hazards SME to serve as a Technical Authority. The successful candidate will act as a recognized industry expert, applying a proven track record to solve complex engineering challenges, influence clients, and mentor engineering teams. This position is critical for driving technical excellence across major international projects. Key Responsibilities Act as the Technical Authority across multiple projects. Lead technical reviews during Concept, FEED, and Detailed Design phases. Perform independent design assurance and peer reviews. Resolve complex engineering challenges and provide specialist guidance. Support proposals, client workshops, and business development initiatives. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the technical capability development of the THSE team. Develop and maintain engineering standards and best practices. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 20 years of experience in process safety and major accident hazard management. Demonstrated expertise in solving complex engineering challenges. Proven ability to influence clients and drive technical excellence in major international projects. Experience in mentoring engineering teams. Work Type This is a full-time position. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications are encouraged to apply.

9504d1917625c40a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة محور الشبكات التجارية عن مساعد إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى دعم العمليات الإدارية اليومية وضمان سير العمل بكفاءة عالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ التعليمات الإدارية الصادرة عن الرئيس المباشر ومتابعة القرارات الإدارية. إدارة البريد الوارد (الورقي والإلكتروني) وتوزيعه والرد عليه حسب التوجيهات. إنجاز أعمال الطباعة، الرد على الاستفسارات والمكالمات الهاتفية، وتنظيم الملفات. حفظ المعاملات والوثائق بطريقة منظمة تسهل الرجوع إليها. تنسيق وتنظيم اجتماعات الرئيس المباشر وموظفي الوحدة التنظيمية، وتدوين محاضرها وتوزيعها. إدخال وتحديث بيانات الشركة والموظفين بدقة في الأنظمة والسجلات المعتمدة. متابعة معاملات الشركة والموظفين عبر المنصات الحكومية مثل قوى، مدد، التأمينات الاجتماعية، ومقيم. متابعة مواعيد انتهاء العقود والإقامات ورخص العمل، والتنسيق لإجراءات التجديد. إعداد وتنسيق الخطابات والمستندات باستخدام Microsoft Word، وتجهيز الجداول والتقارير باستخدام Microsoft Excel. تنظيم ومتابعة البريد الإلكتروني الإداري والمراسلات باستخدام Microsoft Outlook. أرشفة ملفات الموظفين والعقود والمستندات مع الحفاظ على سريتها. التنسيق مع الإدارة والمحاسبة لاستكمال البيانات والمستندات اللازمة للمعاملات. إعداد تقارير دورية بالمهام المنجزة والمعاملات المعلقة ومواعيد استحقاقها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية في استخدام المنصات الحكومية وشؤون الموظفين. خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إداري ذي صلة. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والسرعة في إدخال البيانات. القدرة على تنظيم الملفات ومتابعة المهام المتعددة. مهارات تواصل جيدة وفعالة. القدرة على كتابة المراسلات الإدارية بوضوح واحترافية. إتقان استخدام برامج Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook). بيئة العمل يعمل المساعد الإداري بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة محور الشبكات التجارية في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، مما يوفر بيئة عمل داعمة ومتعاونة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

Partner with account executives and creative strategists throughout the RFP process to develop innovative, insight-driven digital campaigns on Snapchat, bringing measurable ROI for clients. 951c38a131d0a2b4.description: About the Company and Role NES Global Talent is seeking a Senior Engine Testing & Performance Engineer (Electrical) for a full-time position. Our client is a Saudi industrial joint venture specializing in the manufacturing and servicing of large marine and land-based engines across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region. This company is the first in the region dedicated to these specialized engine applications. Role Overview The Senior 2-Stroke Engine Testing & Performance Engineer is responsible for conducting and evaluating test results for large 2- and 4-stroke engines, ensuring compliance with operational and legislative standards. This role involves leading troubleshooting efforts for electrical and instrumentation issues during engine production, acceptance tests, and post-commissioning phases. The engineer will manage and resolve electrical system and instrument-related issues throughout the production process and after engine operation to ensure high reliability and performance in field conditions. Key Responsibilities Perform Factory Acceptance Tests for 2- and 4-stroke large engines, evaluate results, and generate required documentation such as NOx technical files and other reports. Design electrical and instrumentation systems for large engine manufacturing, establishing technology and drawing standards. Collaborate with licensors and technical partners to resolve electrical and instrumentation engineering problems. Standardize electrical component integration and instrument calibration processes to enhance engine performance and reliability. Coordinate with production planning and procurement to ensure timely availability of electrical components and instrumentation tools for engine production. Interact with the Quality Management department to address electrical or instrumentation issues during production and implement corrective actions. Troubleshoot engine quality issues related to electrical and instrumentation systems during production with the Operations Business Line or with customers. Analyze system performance data for electrical systems and instrumentation, identify trends, and drive improvements for operational efficiency and reduced downtime. Provide technical support to production technicians and operators on electrical systems and instrumentation, including troubleshooting and problem resolution. Ensure all electrical and instrumentation designs comply with industry safety standards and environmental regulations. Perform additional duties related to electrical systems and instrumentation design and implementation as assigned. Work Type This is a full-time position. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

957376b4a91e9349.description: Footwear Designer - Tech Pack Design Location: India and GCC countries (United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Oman) Experience: 3-6 years About the Company We are a footwear brand building commercially relevant products for customers across diverse markets. Our team connects creative design with disciplined product development, ensuring each style can move from concept to production with clear specifications, dependable quality, and strong market fit. This role supports a business that is expanding access to talent across India and the GCC, bringing together regional insight, supplier coordination, and product craftsmanship. Team members are expected to take ownership, communicate clearly, and use structured documentation to reduce ambiguity across design, development, sourcing, and manufacturing. We encourage practical problem-solving, thoughtful iteration, and accountability for the final product rather than design intent alone. By joining our team, you will help shape footwear collections, strengthen technical execution, and improve the speed and reliability with which new products reach customers. The position is confidential, so company-identifying details are intentionally not disclosed. About the Role As a Footwear Designer, you will own the technical translation of footwear concepts into accurate, production-ready tech packs. You will define construction details, materials, colourways, measurements, artwork, trims, and finishing requirements so suppliers and manufacturing teams can execute the intended product consistently. The role combines footwear design understanding with rigorous documentation and cross-functional follow-through. You will work closely with internal stakeholders and external development partners to review samples, identify gaps, manage revisions, and resolve issues before production. Success means reducing rework, improving sample accuracy, protecting quality, and helping the brand deliver commercially relevant footwear on schedule. You may support styles serving customers across India and the GCC, so practical awareness of regional preferences and production requirements will be valuable. This is an onsite, mid-level opportunity for a designer who can operate independently while communicating clearly across creative and technical teams. Key Responsibilities Create complete footwear tech packs covering specifications, construction, materials, colourways, components, measurements, artwork, labelling, packaging, and finishing requirements for accurate supplier execution. Translate design concepts into manufacturable products by evaluating construction choices, material suitability, production constraints, target costs, quality standards, and intended customer experience. Coordinate sample development with suppliers and internal teams, documenting feedback, tracking revisions, and closing technical gaps before approvals and production handover. Review prototypes and samples against approved specifications, identify deviations, and drive corrective actions that improve fit, appearance, function, consistency, and manufacturing readiness. Maintain organized product records, version control, and technical updates so design, sourcing, development, and manufacturing stakeholders work from one reliable source of truth. Contribute design solutions aligned with footwear trends, customer needs, commercial objectives, and regional market insights across India and GCC markets. Manage assigned styles and development milestones with clear priorities, timely communication, and escalation of risks affecting quality, cost, or launch timelines. Essential Skills & Technologies Strong footwear tech pack creation skills, including technical drawings, specifications, construction details, material callouts, colourways, measurements, artwork, and component documentation. Working knowledge of footwear construction, materials, sampling, fit review, manufacturing processes, supplier communication, and quality-control requirements. Proficiency with relevant design and documentation tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, PLM, CAD, or comparable footwear product-development systems. Additional Plus Experience developing multiple footwear categories, including knowledge of how construction, materials, fit, and performance requirements vary across product types. Exposure to suppliers or manufacturing partners in India, the GCC, or other international footwear production markets, with the ability to manage development remotely when required. Awareness of regional consumer preferences, footwear trends, costing considerations, and commercial product decisions that improve market relevance. A portfolio demonstrating footwear concepts, technical drawings, completed tech packs, sample iterations, and production-ready product outcomes. What You'll Bring You will bring 3–6 years of footwear design or footwear product-development experience, with strong evidence of creating and managing production-ready tech packs. You understand how design intent becomes a physical product and can make practical decisions about construction, materials, components, fit, comfort, appearance, durability, and manufacturing feasibility. You are detail-oriented without losing sight of commercial priorities, and you can explain technical requirements clearly to suppliers, developers, and cross-functional partners. You work confidently with design and documentation software and maintain disciplined version control across multiple styles. You are comfortable reviewing samples, identifying deviations, incorporating feedback, and driving actions through closure. You take ownership of deadlines and escalate risks early when they could affect quality, cost, or delivery. Experience working with footwear factories, vendors, or international teams will strengthen your fit for the role. A relevant bachelor’s degree is useful, though equivalent practical experience will be considered. Most importantly, you combine creative judgment, technical accuracy, structured communication, and accountability for the final product. Why Join Us Own visible footwear products from concept translation through production readiness, with direct influence on quality, manufacturability, customer appeal, and commercial outcomes. Work across India and GCC market contexts, gaining exposure to varied customer preferences, suppliers, development practices, and regional product opportunities. Join a practical, cross-functional environment where strong documentation and thoughtful design decisions reduce rework and accelerate dependable product delivery. What We Offer An onsite role with the opportunity to work closely with footwear design, development, sourcing, supplier, and manufacturing stakeholders. Scope to influence product standards, improve technical workflows, and contribute to a growing footwear portfolio across India and GCC markets. A confidential hiring process that protects company identity while providing clear expectations about ownership, deliverables, and success measures.
